description: Review a server's security the way an attacker would look at it, and list findings from high to low with a fix for each: powers held by everyone or by everyday roles, roles that can raise their own power through Manage Roles, bots with Administrator, powerful roles offered in onboarding or handed out by invites, 2FA for moderators, verification, the media filter, AutoMod, webhooks, and permanent invites. Read only; it changes nothing.
